source.author: RETAILBOSS Team
source.title: Pandora Reports 6% Q3 Organic Growth and Raises Guidance Floor
source.checked_against: Second outlets blocked for the agent's fetcher (JCK, FashionNetwork, Quartz: 403; WWD: TollBit redirect; Investing.com: connection closed). Web-search result summaries of Investing.com/WWD coverage gave the same 6% organic, 4% LFL, 20/6/3/1% regional LFL, 15.9% reported EBIT margin, 370 bp one-off, 1% October LFL and 2-3% guidance; no verbatim quote taken from them.

figures.quote: Its November 4 results update also narrowed the 2026 EBIT-margin outlook

figures.text: 6% organic growth in the third quarter of 2026
figures.quote: Pandora delivered 6% organic growth in the third quarter of 2026

figures.text: like-for-like growth 4% plus 2% from network expansion and other factors
figures.quote: Like-for-like growth of 4% combined with a 2% contribution from network expansion and other factors to produce the organic-growth result.

figures.text: regional like-for-like: Asia-Pacific 20%, Latin America 6%, North America 3%, EMEA 1%
figures.quote: Asia-Pacific led regional like-for-like growth at 20%, followed by Latin America at 6%, North America at 3% and EMEA at 1%.

figures.text: reported EBIT margin 15.9%; partial US tariff refund one-off benefit 370 basis points = 3.7 percentage points
figures.quote: The reported EBIT margin rose to 15.9%, but a partial U.S. tariff refund contributed a one-off benefit of 370 basis points.

figures.text: underlying EBIT margin broadly flat year over year
figures.quote: Pandora said its underlying EBIT margin was broadly flat year over year.
The jewelry company now expects annual organic growth of 2%–3%, compared with 0%–3% previously.
narrowed the 2026 EBIT-margin outlook to 22.5%–23%, from 22%–23%.

figures.text: October like-for-like growth 1%, reduced promotional activity weighing
figures.quote: October like-for-like growth was 1%, with reduced promotional activity weighing on the figure.

figures.text: preparing changes to product design, local marketing, store experience
figures.quote: Pandora is preparing changes to product design, locally relevant marketing and the store experience.

figures.text: reported margin improvement included a one-off benefit, not an equal underlying gain
figures.quote: the reported margin improvement included a one-off benefit, rather than an equivalent underlying gain.
